per_token_bytes.row_alignment: sparse_sdpa requires K rows of a multiple of 64 B on Blackhole (ttnn/cpp/ttnn/operations/transformer/sdpa/device/sparse_sdpa_device_operation.cpp:208-214). A 544-column fp8 row is 544 B (not aligned), so the fp8 block-sharded row is 576 columns (512 latent + 64 control) = 576 B. The 544-based figures of stage-6 review #2 (2,200 / 1,672 B per token) are therefore 88 B per token too low.

dsa_block_sharded_fp8.pool_key_sharding_a: not implemented. Op contract: indexer_score_dsa scores k.logical_shape()[2] keys and needs page-table ids below the view's 32-key tiles (ttnn/cpp/ttnn/operations/experimental/indexer_score/device/indexer_score_device_operation.cpp:95-99), so the [KB, 1, P_alloc, 128] pool-key view must hold P_alloc keys on every die whatever the ownership. Sharding needs a compact per-die pool numbering (per-die limits and id maps in the prefill inputs and in the decode trace) plus a per-die top-512 and a merge top-k. Not needed for 1,048,576 at 1 slot; it would raise multi-slot capacity
dsa_block_sharded_fp8.serving_profile_recommendation: a separate 1-slot long profile: max_num_seqs 1, max_model_len 1,048,576, GLM53_DSA_SHARD=1, 600 MiB workspace (GLM53_DRAM_RESERVE_MIB=600 for the standalone generator), GLM53_MOE_SORTED_ROWS=512, GLM53_DSA_INDEX_BLOCK_MB=32. The default profiles stay replicated (faster: -2.9 ms per token). The vLLM adapter / serving_profiles.json do not have a per-profile DSA layout yet (stage 9 / 10 item)
